change: Express Entry Comprehensive Ranking System changes announced for high-wage occupations
affected_cohort: Express Entry candidates with eligible Canadian work experience in high-wage occupations or a qualifying high-wage job offer; candidate must meet route-specific requirements
observed_fact: IRCC announced additional CRS points for eligible Canadian work experience or qualifying job offers in high-wage occupations; the two options are not combined. From 2026-11-03, LMIA will no longer be required for qualifying job offers used for these points and specified Federal Skilled Worker/Skilled Trades eligibility requirements. A high-wage occupation is defined as at least 1.3 times the median wage of the overall Canadian workforce.
pathway_mechanism: Could change relative invitation prospects for eligible candidates with Canadian work experience or qualifying high-wage offers; may alter employer/job-offer friction.
directional_eom_impact: Potentially lowers pathway-friction energy for the affected eligible cohort relative to other profiles; no numeric energy adjustment assigned.
counterfactual_or_caveat: Announcement is not yet effective on this run date. CRS points do not guarantee an invitation or permanent residence. Do not generalise to all migrants or occupations; no causal effect estimated.
